description: We’re a Trivandrum-based team taking on “Create Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions.” Our idea is an AI/ML-powered system that tracks vitals and flags early health risks, with a game-like interactive dashboard and animated visuals that make the data easy to read for crews and mission control. We’re looking for teammates skilled in data analysis, ML, web/software development, UI design, and storytelling. Beginners welcome!
summary: AstroVitals is a web dashboard that helps monitor astronaut health during space missions. It tracks heart rate, blood oxygen, temperature, sleep, and radiation exposure for each crew member, adjusts normal ranges for each mission phase (launch, orbit, EVA, return), and turns raw numbers into a simple risk score with plain-language explanations. Microgravity and radiation affect the human body in ways that are hard to track, and crews far from Earth need fast, clear insight. AstroVitals gives mission teams and flight surgeons an easy way to spot early warning signs and act before problems grow.
